raw.query: SELECT model, window_name, quantile, rho, readiness, lead_s, round(ws::numeric,1) as ws, round(denom_static_c8_ws::numeric,1) as denom_ws, round(ratio_vs_static::numeric,4) as ratio FROM provenance.ewma_ablation_cell WHERE model='chronos' AND window_name='aggregate' AND quantile='p90' AND rho=15 AND readiness='warm' AND lead_s=30;
raw.claimed: Controller inference cost: <0.001x impact (duty cycle <0.8% at 15s tick); CPU configs 0.65-0.66x static.
raw.evidence: ewma_ablation_cell confirms the baseline ratio of 0.6231. Sensitivity files confirm GPU duty cycle is 0.086%-0.78% (<0.8% at 15s), moving the arm by <=0.0010x, and feasible CPU-class configurations are 0.65-0.66x.
